Harlem Globetrotters return to Casper with new ‘Rivalry Tour’

by Dan Cepeda September 28, 2026September 28, 2026

Share this:

  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook
  • Print (Opens in new window) Print

CASPER, Wyo. –– The legendary Harlem Globetrotters have announced their return to Casper early next year for the “Rivalry Tour” series.

According to a release, the basketball troupe will perform at the Ford Wyoming Center on Thursday, Feb. 11, 2027. Tickets will go on sale on Friday, Oct. 2 at 10 a.m.

“This tour is unlike any other in 100 years, with a whole new game, a new lineup of rivals, and all-new challenges that raise the stakes at every stop,” the release said. Each fan will have the chance to participate in a pre-game tipoff party, and fan packages for added access and events are available at extra cost.

Advertisement

“The Harlem Globetrotters, The Washington Generals, and the new lineup of rivals joining the tour will all debut new game uniforms and fan merchandise, featuring new team colorways and a fresh look built for this new era of the Rivalry,” they said. Special merch will also be available marking the 75th anniversary of the team’s rivalry with the Washington Generals.

Tickets and information can be found at the Harlem Globetrotters’ official website.
